regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, two-theme leadership structure: Banks rank 1 (eligible, durable, but crowded) with Innovative Pharma & CXO rank 2 (also crowded, barely behind). Momentum is an attention lens only; the absolute-trend gate did NOT help on China A-shares history (gate_helps=false), so this whole read is experimental and the only validated edge is absent here. Track record is weak on direction (dir_accuracy 0.377), so conviction must be low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) sustains a durability_bar above Banks for 5 consecutive sessions — that would retire the watch as a confirmed handoff candidate, otherwise the two-theme Banks-led structure stands.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the rank-1 eligible theme with the highest durability_bar (0.73) and strong breadth (0.889), which is the only coherent leg here since the momentum rank itself is not alpha. The crowding flag (crowding_z 1.78) is a size-down caution, not a fade; I lean with direction but acknowledge the gate has no verified drawdown edge in this market.
theses.dissent: The trend gate did not hold on China A-shares historically, so even the strongest eligible theme can whipsaw violently, and the crowded flag means any mean-reversion snap could hit this leadership hardest.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS gives up its 20-day relative lead over the CSI 300 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the eligible challenger, nearly tied at score 0.988 with durability_bar 0.60 and decent breadth (0.643). Relative to Banks it is less durable but also slightly less extended on breadth, so it is a second eligible theme rather than a confirmed handoff. Direction only, no size.
theses.dissent: It is crowded alongside Banks in a narrow rotation (only 4 of 22 themes eligible), and with no validated rotation-timing edge there is no basis to expect this challenger to overtake the leader within a month.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags the CSI 300 while 512800.SS holds its lead for 10 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is eligible but its hurst_tag is mean-revert, which is the opposite of the trend-following posture this desk runs. With gate_helps=false and the theme's own structure pointing to mean-reversion, there is no reason to carry a directional lean here.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert could mean Coal snaps back up if the tape rolls over, but that is a timing call the detector explicitly does not support.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS breaks above its 20-day high and the hurst_tag flips to trend before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
